title: Accepted but Wrong: Silent Failures of LLM Code Repairs after API Migrations
title_zh: 被接受但错误：API迁移后大语言模型代码修复的静默失败

paragraphs.en: 研究发现API迁移后LLM修复的代码可能静默失败，边缘输入测试可将错误发布率大幅降低。 After a runtime or API migration, an LLM-repaired procedure can run cleanly yet return wrong results, and a release check on typical test inputs ships it. We report a preregistered study of 73 tasks covering 60 documented changes in CPython, Node.js and SQLite. Every candidate is executed on the real runtimes against withheld contracts. Over the complete repair space, the all-assertions gate on typical inputs released 0.410 of wrong repairs. One edge input written from the release note cut this to 0.065, and to 0.061 on 15 unseen clusters. Three inputs from a blind GPT-5.6-luna writer that never saw the program reached 0.070. Two further frozen stages enlarged the menu to 1491 fragments and then added 233 hard distractors that match the legacy output on typical inputs. The edge input (0.058) and the frontier-model writer (0.058) passed their preregistered tests. Yet 0.168 and 0.153 of the hard wrong programs still passed. Two local-model writers failed their preregistered tests. Across four model families, the edge input cut wrong releases per attempt in all three open-weight families on all three menus, for example from 0.233 to 0.057, without lowering correct completion. Self-tests helped less. A blind AI audit flagged 34 contracts as stricter than their requirements. Dropping the disputed checks changed 0 verdicts, but class-label disputes remain open. No model-written code was executed. Artifacts are available from the authors on request.
paragraphs.zh: 研究发现API迁移后LLM修复的代码可能静默失败，边缘输入测试可将错误发布率大幅降低。 在运行时或API迁移之后，经LLM修复的过程可能正常运行却返回错误结果，而基于典型测试输入的发布检查会将其发布出去。 我们报告了一项预注册的研究，涵盖CPython、Node.js和SQLite中60个有文档记录的变更，共73个任务。 每个候选程序都在真实的运行时上针对保留的契约进行执行。 在完整的修复空间上，基于典型输入的全断言门控发布了0.410的错误修复。 一条根据发布说明编写的边缘输入将这一比例降至0.065，在15个未见过的集群上降至0.061。 三条来自从未见过该程序的盲测GPT-5.6-luna编写者的输入达到了0.070。 随后的两个冻结阶段将菜单扩大到1491个片段，然后添加了233个在典型输入上与旧输出匹配的困难干扰项。 边缘输入（0.058）和前沿模型编写者（0.058）通过了其预注册测试。 然而，仍有0.168和0.153的困难错误程序通过了测试。 两个本地模型编写者未能通过其预注册测试。 在四个模型家族中，边缘输入在所有三个开放权重家族的所有三个菜单上都降低了每次尝试的错误发布率，例如从0.233降至0.057，同时未降低正确完成率。自测的帮助较小。 一次盲测AI审计将34个契约标记为比其要求更严格。 移除有争议的检查未改变任何判定结果，但类别标签的争议仍未解决。 没有执行任何模型编写的代码。 相关材料可向作者索取。
